ui.title: Vehicle Hacker
ui.no_tags_hint: Stand next to a vehicle and use a Vehicle Tag. Tagged vehicles within {n} m show up here.
ui.remove_all_confirm: Tap again to remove all tags
ui.aim_hint_phone: Your camera opens. Point it at a vehicle within {n} m and press the shutter.
ui.aim_hint_standalone: The screen goes away and a crosshair appears. Look at a vehicle within {n} m and click. Backspace cancels.
ui.speed_bomb: Explodes the vehicle if its speed drops below {n} {unit}. Arms after {delay} s.
ui.unavailable_hint: No response from the vehicle link. Check your signal and try again.
ui.lost: Lost the link to that vehicle.
ui.crosshair_locked:
Vehicle Hacker

ui.crosshair_looking:
Vehicle Hacker
Look at a vehicle and click  -  Backspace to cancel

errors.gone: That vehicle is no longer there.
errors.out_of_range: That vehicle is out of range.
errors.own_vehicle: You can't hack the vehicle you are in.
errors.no_tag_item: You don't have a vehicle tag.

errors.too_far: You are too far from the vehicle.
